$comment: THE ONE LIST of every refusal the receipt verifiers raise: this package's verifyReceipt and the Python SDK's verify(). Each entry is clause -> name -> one-sentence meaning -> what the developer does. packages/acp-verify/src/refusal-names.ts and sdk/python/src/ziffer/_refusal_names.py are GENERATED from this file by tools/gen-refusal-names.py, and its --check holds both, the clauses both verifiers raise and the engine's receipt-path clauses at the pin to it, by name. Edit this file, never the generated ones. `clause` is spelled exactly as the engine spells it and never changes; `name` is what a developer reads first. `section` is the number of the specification heading that states the clause; the link to that heading is derived from the specification at the engine pin, never typed. `who` is who fixes it, as the support guide's refusal table sorts it: `you`, `us` or `you and us`.

unnamed.name: UnnamedRefusal
unnamed.meaning: The receipt was refused under a rule this version of the SDK has no name for.
unnamed.action: Do not act on the receipt. Update the SDK to its latest version; if the refusal stays unnamed, report it with the receipt and the rule in brackets.

engine_only.9.3-4: the policy basis: needs the verifier's own signed bundle, which the stateless verifiers do not take
engine_only.9.3-8: the tenant: needs the signed bundle's tenant
engine_only.TR-8: the recomputed risk: needs the signed bundle's grading rules
engine_only.RV-3: the recomputed reversibility: needs the signed bundle's reversibility table

refusals.name: ReceiptVersionUnsupported
refusals.meaning: What you passed as the receipt is not a version 3 receipt.
refusals.action: Pass the receipt exactly as the decision API returned it, unchanged. If you did, report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: ReceiptTooLarge
refusals.meaning: The receipt's signed body is larger than the 4,096 bytes a receipt is signed within.
refusals.action: Do not act on the receipt and do not retry. Report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: SuiteUnknown
refusals.meaning: The receipt names a signature suite this verifier does not know or names none, or the suite floor you configured is not a suite it knows.
refusals.action: Check the spelling of the suite floor you configured (ZIFFER_SUITE_FLOOR), then update the SDK. If both are right, report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: SuiteBelowFloor
refusals.meaning: The receipt, or an approval sent with it, is not signed with a suite that contains every algorithm your suite floor requires.
refusals.action: Confirm the suite floor you configured is the one you meant. If it is, do not act on the receipt and report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: NotCanonicallyEncodable
refusals.meaning: The receipt, an approval or the proposal you passed holds a value with no canonical encoding, such as a fractional number, or the proposal bytes are not UTF-8 JSON.
refusals.action: Pass the exact proposal bytes you sent and the receipt exactly as it was returned. Remove any step that re-encodes either one on the way.

refusals.name: SignatureInvalid
refusals.meaning: The receipt's signature does not verify under your trust anchor's keys.
refusals.action: Do not act on the receipt and do not retry. Confirm your trust anchor is the one on your handover sheet, then report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: DecisionNotAllow
refusals.meaning: The receipt records a decision other than ALLOW.
refusals.action: Do not run the action. Report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: ReceiptNotBoundToProposal
refusals.meaning: The receipt is not bound to the proposal you passed.
refusals.action: Pass the exact proposal this receipt answered. When several calls are in flight, match each receipt to its own proposal before verifying.

refusals.name: ReceiptTimeUnreadable
refusals.meaning: The receipt's issue or expiry time is missing or is not an RFC 3339 UTC instant.
refusals.action: Do not act on the receipt. Pass it exactly as the decision API returned it; if you did, report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: ReceiptExpired
refusals.meaning: Your clock is past the receipt's expiry time.
refusals.action: Keep the verifying host's clock on UTC time, and verify a receipt as soon as it arrives: it is valid for 120 seconds. Propose the action again for a new receipt.

refusals.name: ReceiptIssuedInFuture
refusals.meaning: The receipt's issue time is more than 5 seconds ahead of your clock.
refusals.action: Synchronise the verifying host's clock with UTC time, then verify the receipt again.

refusals.name: ValidityWindowTooLong
refusals.meaning: The receipt is valid for longer than the 120 seconds a receipt may be.
refusals.action: Do not act on the receipt and do not retry. Report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: NonceMalformed
refusals.meaning: A nonce in the receipt, or in an approval sent with it, is not `b64:` followed by padded base64.
refusals.action: Do not act on the receipt and do not retry. Report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: ReceiptNonceWrongSize
refusals.meaning: The receipt's nonce is well formed but is not 128 bits long.
refusals.action: Do not act on the receipt and do not retry. Report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: ApprovalsUnverifiable
refusals.meaning: The approvals sent with the receipt cannot be matched to the list the receipt signed: a list is malformed, an approval is not on it, or the verifier was given no attester registry.
refusals.action: Give the verifier your attester registry (ZIFFER_ATTESTER_REGISTRY, or the registry argument). If you did, do not act on the receipt and report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: ApprovalDigestsUnsorted
refusals.meaning: The receipt's list of approval digests is not in sorted order.
refusals.action: Do not act on the receipt and do not retry. Report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: ApprovalDigestsDuplicated
refusals.meaning: The receipt's list of approval digests names one approval more than once.
refusals.action: Do not act on the receipt and do not retry. Report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: ApprovalCountMismatch
refusals.meaning: The number of approvals sent with the receipt is not the number of approvals the receipt signed.
refusals.action: Pass the receipt and its approvals exactly as the decision API returned them. If you did, report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: ApprovalsMissing
refusals.meaning: The receipt commits to approvals and none were sent with it.
refusals.action: Pass the receipt with its attestations exactly as the decision API returned them. If you did, report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: ApprovalObjectMissing
refusals.meaning: An approval sent with the receipt carries no approval object.
refusals.action: Do not act on the receipt and do not retry. Report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: ApprovalObjectMalformed
refusals.meaning: An approval object lacks a required field, carries a field that is not defined, or holds a field of the wrong type.
refusals.action: Do not act on the receipt and do not retry. Report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: ApprovalNonceWrongSize
refusals.meaning: An approval's nonce is well formed but is not 128 bits long.
refusals.action: Do not act on the receipt and do not retry. Report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: ApprovalSignatureInvalid
refusals.meaning: An approval's signature does not verify against the key your attester registry holds for that approver, or your registry does not enrol that approver.
refusals.action: Check that the approver is enrolled in your attester registry with their current key. If they are, do not act on the receipt and report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: ApprovalNotBoundToProposal
refusals.meaning: An approval sent with the receipt is not bound to the proposal you passed.
refusals.action: Do not act on the receipt and do not retry. Report it with the receipt and the proposal.

refusals.name: ApprovalContextMismatch
refusals.meaning: An approval names another policy version than the receipt, expired before the receipt was issued, or has an unreadable policy, expiry or operator field.
refusals.action: Propose the action again so that it is approved under the current policy. If it happens again, report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: ApprovalsDisagreeOnOperator
refusals.meaning: The approvals sent with the receipt name different operators.
refusals.action: Do not act on the receipt and do not retry. Report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: ApprovalQuorumSizeMismatch
refusals.meaning: An approver consented to a number of required approvals other than the quorum your attester registry sets.
refusals.action: Propose the action again so that it is approved under the current policy. If it happens again, report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: ApprovalIdMismatch
refusals.meaning: An approval's transmitted identifier is not the identifier computed from its content.
refusals.action: Do not act on the receipt and do not retry. Report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: ApproverAssuranceTooLow
refusals.meaning: An approver is enrolled at an assurance level below your attester registry's floor, or at a level outside AS0 to AS2.
refusals.action: Enrol the approver at the assurance level your registry requires, or have an approver enrolled at that level approve instead.

refusals.name: QuorumNotMet
refusals.meaning: Fewer distinct approvers approved the action than the quorum your attester registry sets.
refusals.action: Do not run the action. Check your registry's approvers and roles against who approved; propose the action again once enough approvers can answer.

refusals.name: OperatorApprovedOwnAction
refusals.meaning: The operator who proposed the action is counted among its approvers.
refusals.action: Do not run the action. Have approvers other than the operator approve it.

refusals.name: ApproverKeyTypeMismatch
refusals.meaning: An approval claims a kind of key, a person's passkey or a machine key, that is not the kind your attester registry enrols for that approver.
refusals.action: Do not act on the receipt and do not retry. Report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: PasskeyCounterNotAdvanced
refusals.meaning: A passkey or security key's signature counter did not advance, so the credential was copied or the approval was replayed.
refusals.action: Do not act on the receipt. Treat the approver's authenticator as compromised and re-enrol it before it approves anything else.

refusals.name: ApprovalMalformed
refusals.meaning: A person's approval, or the key your attester registry holds for them, is not in the shape a passkey approval takes.
refusals.action: Check the approver's entry in your attester registry against the credential they enrolled. If it matches, report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: PasskeyAssertionTypeInvalid
refusals.meaning: A person's approval is not a passkey sign-in assertion.
refusals.action: Ask the approver to approve again from your approval page.

refusals.name: PasskeyChallengeMismatch
refusals.meaning: A person's approval answers a different request than this approval.
refusals.action: Do not act on the receipt. Ask the approver to approve again from your approval page; if it happens again, report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: PasskeyOriginMismatch
refusals.meaning: A person's approval was made on a site other than your approval page.
refusals.action: Ask the approver to approve again from your own approval page. If they did, report it with the receipt.

refusals.name: PasskeyAuthenticatorDataInvalid
refusals.meaning: A person's approval names another site, or does not show that the person was present and verified.
refusals.action: Ask the approver to approve again and to complete the fingerprint, face or PIN step their authenticator asks for.

refusals.name: PasskeySignatureInvalid
refusals.meaning: A person's approval signature does not verify against the passkey or security key your attester registry holds for them.
refusals.action: Check that the approver's entry in your attester registry holds their current credential. If it does, do not act on the receipt and report it with the receipt.
